channel.title: Kotric: Fabric Crafts, DIY Projects & Sewing
channel.description: Fabric craft ideas, no-sew DIY projects and sewing tutorials.

item.title: 17 Clever Ways to Upcycle Old Jeans (Most Need No Sewing)
item.description: Turn worn-out jeans into tote bags, coasters, pot holders, rag rugs and more. Easy denim upcycling ideas, from no-sew to beginner sewing.

item.title: 25 Fabric Scrap Projects That Use Up Every Last Piece
item.description: Fabric scrap ideas sorted by scrap size, from tiny snippets to fat-quarter leftovers: scrunchies, coasters, bunting, pet beds, quilts and more.

item.title: Beginner Sewing Kit: The 15 Essentials (and What to Skip)
item.description: Exactly what to put in a beginner sewing kit: needles, thread, scissors, pins, marking tools and more — plus the gadgets you don't need yet.

item.title: 7 Hand Sewing Stitches Every Beginner Should Know
item.description: Learn the running stitch, backstitch, whip stitch, slip stitch, blanket stitch, basting and the knot that starts them all — with when to use each one.

item.title: Fabric Glue vs Fusible Web vs Hem Tape: Which No-Sew Method Wins?
item.description: Compare the main no-sew fabric bonding methods — fabric glue, fusible web, iron-on hem tape and hot glue — for strength, washability and best uses.

item.title: How to Make a No-Sew Fleece Tie Blanket (Any Size)
item.description: Step-by-step guide to a no-sew fleece tie blanket: how much fleece to buy for baby, throw and twin sizes, how to cut the fringe and the best knot to use.

item.title: How to Organize Your Fabric Stash (A System That Actually Lasts)
item.description: A simple, repeatable system to organize fabric: purge, sort by type and color, fold to a uniform size, label, and keep the stash under control.

item.title: 21 Sewing Room Organization Ideas for Any Size Space
item.description: Practical sewing room and craft corner organization ideas: thread storage, pattern filing, pegboards, cutting stations and small-space hacks.

item.title: Fabric Types Guide: 14 Common Fabrics and What to Make With Them
item.description: A beginner-friendly guide to cotton, linen, flannel, fleece, felt, denim, canvas, jersey and more — how each behaves and the best projects for it.

item.title: 20 Sewing Hacks That Make Every Project Easier
item.description: Clever sewing hacks for threading needles, perfect seam allowances, sharp corners, easy hems and tidy workspaces — tested tips that save time.

item.title: How to Sew a Button by Hand (Flat and Shank Buttons)
item.description: Learn how to sew on a two-hole, four-hole and shank button by hand, including how to make a thread shank so buttons don't pop off again.

item.title: Should You Prewash Fabric? How and When to Do It
item.description: When to prewash fabric, which fabrics shrink the most, how to stop fraying in the wash and how to prewash cotton, linen, flannel, wool and more.
